scope: Read-only inspection of installed tile-kernels source; not execution of native 950 kernels or upstream package integrity certification

activation_policy.scale_rounding: ceil(log2(amax/448)), exponent extracted from FP32 reciprocal multiply
activation_policy.narrowing: deterministic E4M3 RNE; stochastic path not implemented
activation_policy.native_packing: INT16 on Ascend, INT32 on GPU; adjacent K-group exponent bytes; column-major optional
activation_policy.native_scale_specials: packed exponent0 reinterprets as FP32zero, unlike raw E8M0byte0=2^-127; explicit adapter rejects logical exponent0/255, ignores pad bytes

swiglu_policy.operation_order: FP32 gate/(1+exp(-gate)) * up, then optional route weight, then FP8 quantization; no intermediate BF16 rounding

implementation_decision: Explicit pure-Torch software activation producer and descriptor; keep native model dispatch unchanged until validated integration
